description:
Dear Tenant,

We are pleased to confirm the terms of your lease: the monthly rent is $1,200.50 and the lease will run for a period of 12 months. In addition to the base rent, the agreement includes a one‑time cleaning fee of $150.00 and a pet fee of $50.00, which will be added to your first month's payment.

Please let us know if you have any questions or need further clarification. We look forward to welcoming you to your new home.
